<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: x-large;"><span lang="zh-CN"><b>苦肉计</b></span></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><i>Inflict Injury On One's Self to Win the Enemy's Trust</i></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
In 227 B.C., the assassin Jing Ke (<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">荆轲</span></span>,
died 227 B.C.) was sent to kill King Zheng (<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">秦王政</span></span>,
221-210 B.C.) of Qin. King Zheng was outraged at General Huan Yi (<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">桓齮</span></span>,
died 227 B.C.) of Qin, a friend of Jing Ke, for betraying him, and so
Jing Ke thought the only way he would be able to get close to King
Zheng was to offer him his friend's head. Jing Ke discussed the plan
with Huan Yi, and Huan Yi, himself wanting vengeance against the
King, agreed to commit suicide so that his head could be collected.
So Jing Ke brought the King the head of his friend, and although the
assassination was not successful, he was able to get close enough to
kill him [26].</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, serif; font-size: large;"><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">Inflict
Injury On One's Self to Win the Enemy's Trust</span></i></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
is associated with the 35th hexagram, <i>Fire
over Earth</i>, an
image suggestive of the sun advancing over the Earth. Notice in the
36th hexagram that Fire has now been covered by the Earth, and that
the strong yang lines are now suppressed beneath the weak yin lines,
suggesting that one's light and intelligence have been intentionally
hidden beneath a feigned injury [1],
[28].</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span>


</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">

<div dir="ltr" id="Section86" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	<span style="font-size: large;">
    1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">把这篇论文打进电脑对他来说是一个挑</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;战。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: It was a challenge
	for him to type the paper into the computer.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	2) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">地毯为什么很粘？</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</span><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">因为小龙把橙汁洒在地上了。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	3) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">注意安全，地上有冰，很滑。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: Be careful, there is
	ice on the ground and it’s very slippery.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">
    4) </span><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">锻炼后，他觉得腿上的肌肉疼。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">
    5) </span><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">老虎是食肉动物。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	6) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">政府要阻止这些移民人进入我们的国家。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	7) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">没有工作许可，他不允许在这里工作。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	8) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我不太喜欢他今天的表现。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	9) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">关于要不要和我们交换，他们还没有确</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;认。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	10)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">她对艺术的热情消失了，她没有和以前</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;一样的创造性了。</span></span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	11)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他是学校的老师，所以他有暑假和寒</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;假。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	12)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这个超市被封起来了。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">
    13)</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: times;"> </span><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">只吃蔬菜对我来说很痛苦。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	14) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这个音响不够响，但是那个太响了。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	15) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">在中国，很少有人吃生的肉。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	16) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他喜欢收藏旧硬币。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	17) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他不喜欢吃肉，除非是熟的。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US">
    18)
	</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">他打字的速度创造了一个新记录。</span></span></p>
</div>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<br /></p>
